title: Bag of Bricks - Purple 40
descriptionHtml:
Purple — colour 40

A deep royal purple with plenty of presence. Ideal for galaxy scenes, bold accents and any design that wants a colour with a bit of drama to it.

Works well with: Sapphire Blue 33, Magenta 08, Lilac 06

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Purple bricks (colour 40) for Memobrick mosaics. A deep royal purple for bold accents, galaxy scenes and regal colour blocks.
